description: Shared render vectors for the prompt template engine (spec 19, part A). Run by the Python suite (knowledge-graph/tests/test_templates.py) and the C# suite. Each case has a full template (front matter + body), the variables, and either 'expect' (exact output), 'error' (rendering fails; message contains the text) or 'load_error' (loading the template fails; message contains the text).
